item.name: 5. List orders - still 30 after re-submit (upsert works)

exec: pm.test("page size 1 returns 1 item and 30 pages", () => { pm.expect(j.content.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.totalPages).to.eql(30); });
pm.test("all returned are HIGH", () => j.content.forEach(o => pm.expect(o.priority).to.eql("HIGH")));
pm.test("7 orders weigh 30 or more", () => pm.expect(j.totalElements).to.eql(7));
pm.test("fields match the sample data", () => { pm.expect(j.address).to.eql("Connaught Place, Delhi, India"); pm.expect(j.packageWeight).to.eql(15); pm.expect(j.priority).to.eql("HIGH"); });
const assigned = j.dispatchPlan.reduce((n, v) => n + v.assignedOrders.length, 0);
pm.test("[invariant] plan has an entry for each of the 5 vehicles", () => pm.expect(j.dispatchPlan.length).to.eql(5));
pm.test("[invariant] no vehicle is over capacity", () => j.dispatchPlan.forEach(v => pm.expect(v.totalLoad).to.be.at.most(v.capacity)));
pm.test("[invariant] no order appears twice", () => pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(ids.length));
pm.test("[invariant] every unassigned order has a reason", () => j.unassignedOrders.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.reason).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty));

pm.test("[invariant] each vehicle load equals the sum of its order weights", () => j.dispatchPlan.forEach(v => pm.expect(v.totalLoad).to.be.closeTo(v.assignedOrders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.packageWeight, 0), 0.001)));
Object.keys(exp).forEach(id => pm.test("[expected] " + id + " load " + exp[id][0] + " and distance " + exp[id][1] + " km", () => {
pm.test("[expected] every unassigned order is LOW priority (HIGH and MEDIUM all fit)", () => j.unassignedOrders.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.order.priority).to.eql("LOW")));
pm.test("[expected] total distance about 85.28 km", () => pm.expect(j.dispatchPlan.reduce((s, v) => s + v.totalDistanceKm, 0)).to.be.closeTo(85.28, 0.1));
pm.test("totalDistance string looks like \"14.44 km\"", () => pm.expect(byId.VEH001.totalDistance).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{2} km$/));
const assigned = j.dispatchPlan.reduce((n, v) => n + v.assignedOrders.length, 0);
pm.test("[invariant] plan has an entry for each of the 5 vehicles", () => pm.expect(j.dispatchPlan.length).to.eql(5));
pm.test("[invariant] no vehicle is over capacity", () => j.dispatchPlan.forEach(v => pm.expect(v.totalLoad).to.be.at.most(v.capacity)));
pm.test("[invariant] no order appears twice", () => pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(ids.length));
pm.test("[invariant] every unassigned order has a reason", () => j.unassignedOrders.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.reason).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty));

pm.test("[invariant] each vehicle load equals the sum of its order weights", () => j.dispatchPlan.forEach(v => pm.expect(v.totalLoad).to.be.closeTo(v.assignedOrders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.packageWeight, 0), 0.001)));
pm.test("two strategies, greedy is the default", () => { pm.expect(j.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.find(s => s.name === "greedy").defaultStrategy).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("one saved plan, and it is ours", () => { pm.expect(j.totalElements).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.content[0].planId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("planId")); });
const n = j.plan.dispatchPlan.reduce((c, v) => c + v.assignedOrders.length, 0) + j.plan.unassignedOrders.length;
pm.test("saved plan covers all 30 orders", () => pm.expect(n).to.eql(30));
pm.test("[expected] 5 vehicles used, 0 idle, 7 LOW unassigned", () => { pm.expect(s.vehiclesUsed).to.eql(5); pm.expect(s.vehiclesIdle).to.eql(0); pm.expect(s.unassignedByPriority.LOW).to.eql(7); });
pm.test("weight changed, other fields kept", () => { pm.expect(j.packageWeight).to.eql(18); pm.expect(j.priority).to.eql("HIGH"); pm.expect(j.address).to.eql("Connaught Place, Delhi, India"); });
